{{Quote|My finest creation, machine of machines, metal enemies welded together and allied toward destruction. Silentior lived to obliterate the Rakata who opposed me, who did not realize I had risen above them. It decimated armies, and it lives for destruction still.|Soa|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Annihilation Droid XRR-3''', named '''Silentior''' by its creator [[Soa]], was originally used to destroy civilizations during the period of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] but was re-programmed to protect the [[Eternity Vault]] prison on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] from anything getting in or out. İt used a sweeping attack to fling nearby enemies away. It could also fire a deadly missile swarm which was very dangerous for enemy soldiers. Additionally, it utilized Storm-protocols which enabled it to assimilate enemy tactics and effectively defend itself against them.
